Metered Commit Gates [E/M · measured_j]

On AMD Kria KV260, whole-SOM VCC_SOM TI INA260 halt-vs-run slopes recorded 11,428 pJ/cycle (11.43 nJ, SE=129 pJ, N=4 25s passes at 25 MHz); 209,261 simulated checks observed 0 false allows (95% UB <= 1.43e-5).

1/2 Sensor & Clopper-Pearson bounds:
- 11.43 nJ/cycle (~1.43 nJ/lane) spans whole SOM (PS+PL+DDR+regs); 98 pJ seed delta (~1.96 mA) is inconclusive near INA260's 1.25 mA LSB
- 0 / 209,261 simulated false allows (95% UB <= 1.43e-5, 79 refusals; sim != universal proof)

2/2 Predicate disagreement & caching:
- NI-4 showed passivity vs CBF gates disagree on edge states — a gate enforces only its encoded math predicate
- 16.7x MoL call cut assumes stationary Zipf(1.1) repeats (1.0x cold)
- KV260 measured_j kept separate from software est_j
